certainty_correction: Prior B diagnosis overstated raw-ring overflow as confirmed. Shared bit7 does not identify the internal source. Retain that historical file, but use this correction for root-cause interpretation.
proven: B and C fail exact whole-message delivery despite all planned inputs and independently exact complete A/B wire frames.
Failure lies after transmitted valid frames on the destination reception/delivery path.
C was fully driven beyond 128ms; 256 deliveries is not a fixture cap.
Original page/application-ring planning did not model the separate 4KiB per-network raw RX ring.
hypotheses: Raw RX ring pressure while serialized long-message output prevents ring draining is a leading cause candidate, especially for B EOF+7 clusters.

C delayed rejections can reflect failed contiguous-fragment admission and/or exhausted/blocked context or delivery-queue resources. Some missing messages reject from their first fragment; all 56 cannot be reduced to direct parser overflow.
unproven: Exact per-event parser versus engine versus reassembly origin.
Raw ring occupied/read-pointer threshold at first failure.
Context/queue/admission reason for each C first-fragment rejection.
Destination application overflow event pin, which the frozen TB does not log.

proposed_diagnostic_not_written_or_run.scope: New isolated read-only hierarchical monitor around unchanged tb_fragmentation; original RTL, vectors, load generator, thresholds and original evidence stay frozen.
proposed_diagnostic_not_written_or_run.bounded_capture: B and C first-failure windows only: capture cycles 650000..950000, terminate after 1000000 cycles (8ms total), with an explicit separate diagnostic result rather than calling it a full workload PASS.
probes: Separate parse_ev_a/b, engine_ev_a/b and reassembly_reject before OR.
Delivery downstream_ready, ring read/release pointers, DQ occupancy/ownership.
Reassembly ready/stream state, both-bank match/free/valid/closed/full, live_ok/bounds_ok, selected previous_end, q_start/q_end, admission valid/ok, pending counts and timeout/checksum reject.
Destination app overflow pin, with public source/wire/output reference retained independently.
proposed_diagnostic_not_written_or_run.stop_condition: Stop once first merged rejection is assigned to a pre-OR source and the violated internal capacity/admission predicate is captured; extend only if that first window does not distinguish candidates.
proposed_diagnostic_not_written_or_run.protection: No signal drives or force, no canonical edits, one diagnostic job at a time under existing process_guard 1GiB process tree/5GiB free and parent scheduling. Compile/run requires explicit parent authorization.

cases.watchdog_note: Frozen TB drives every schedule entry before starting its 2000000-cycle (16ms) delivery watchdog; neither a 128ms absolute cutoff nor a 256-message limit.
cases.bit7_attribution_warning: Nearest EOF time association is observed. Parser/engine/reassembly source identity is not captured; +7 versus +39/+71 is a timing classification, not proof of the emitting block or internal rejection reason.
